reproducibility_gaps: Neither archive states an archive-level license for the ARTL/JDA method source or bundled MAT data; ARTL's LIBLINEAR COPYRIGHT applies only to the bundled third-party component.
MATLAB is identifiable from the source, but no MATLAB version, required toolbox list, complete dependency manifest or top-level installation procedure is provided.
JDA.m adds ../liblinear/matlab to the path, but that directory is absent from the JDA archive; the inspected active JDA paths do not otherwise call LIBLINEAR directly.
The drivers compute or write accuracies but neither archive supplies reference expected results.
ARTL run.m names a variable stderr while assigning std(Accs), leaving the reported statistic semantically mislabeled.
notes: R1 reflects accessible source, bundled data and explicit active entrypoints/configurations, while missing environment and installation prerequisites block R2.
All technical evidence from the two ZIP files remains scoped to the linked archives under the single CR000256 profile identity.
